threads.body:
In old database semconv mode (the default unless `otel.semconv-stability.opt-in` includes `database`), `SqlClientAttributesExtractor` only populates old attributes (e.g., `db.statement`, `db.operation`) when `getRawQueryTexts()` returns a single entry. Returning multiple query texts here will therefore drop old semconv statement/operation/span-name parsing for batch executions.

Consider keeping the multi-query collection only when stable database semconv is enabled, and otherwise return a single joined statement for backward compatibility in old semconv mode.

threads.body: `getRawQueryTexts()` currently returns the internal mutable `List`, which allows external callers to modify `DbExecution` state (and potentially affect attribute extraction in subtle ways). Return an unmodifiable view (or defensively copy) to keep the request object immutable from the outside.

threads.body: When `otel.semconv-stability.opt-in` includes `database/dup`, both stable *and* old DB semconv are emitted (`SemconvStability.emitStableDatabaseSemconv()==true` and `emitOldDatabaseSemconv()==true`). With the current `emitStableDatabaseSemconv() ? rawQueryTexts : singleton(...)` logic, batch executions return multiple raw query texts in dup mode, but `SqlClientAttributesExtractor` only emits legacy `db.statement`/`db.operation` when `rawQueryTexts.size() == 1`, so the old DB attributes will be dropped for batch operations in dup mode (a behavioral regression vs the previous single joined statement).

threads.body:
`getRawQueryTexts()` currently joins the query list into a single string on every call when stable DB semconv is disabled, even for the common single-query case. This method is invoked by both span name extraction and attribute extraction, so it adds avoidable per-request allocations in old-semconv mode.

Consider only joining when there is more than one raw query text (i.e., the batch case that actually needs back-compat behavior), and otherwise returning the original collection directly.

threads.body: [Bug] In old-only database semconv mode, `getRawQueryTexts()` joins batch queries to preserve legacy `db.statement` behavior when query sanitization is disabled. The previous `DbExecution` implementation joined with `";\n"`, but the new join uses `"; "`, which changes the raw `db.statement` value for batch requests when sanitization is disabled (a behavioral regression under the public `R2dbcTelemetryBuilder#setQuerySanitizationEnabled(false)` option). Consider keeping the legacy delimiter in old-only mode.
